provenance.evidence: ROM scene 3 record 95 at 0x18AB8C; after the conditional maglock path, event-table row 3 at 0x18A6FF selects numeric resource-activity scene 30. Return policy: ROM 0xBC36/0xBD34 selects the collision-probe lead point; 0x2F32 restores the source scene. Lua link data records this point and faces away from the entrance on return.

ROM service 3 at 0x53BCC selects this Scene-3/event-3 branch when FFFC1E bit 2 is set, bit 3 is clear, FFF0D5 is zero, and FFFC30 bit 12 or FFFC38 bit 4/5 is set. It opens 0xF4BB4 (text 0xF5B00, portrait 0x12209C), sets FFE180 after the page, and continues through event-table row 3 at 0x18A6FF to resource Scene 30.
